about: Vitruvian Manager's sources, version 1 (PRP-SCHOLAR-USP-DESIGN.md 5.1, stage S1): each with its citation, a short name for legends, the version VM holds, its licence, its address, when VM read it, and its terms as read: 'host' (VM may host its values, with the credit it asks) or 'cite-only' (VM may cite a figure and link to it, but hosts none of its rows). termsUrl, termsQuote and termsRead record where the terms were read, the sentence that decides, and when; credit is the credit the source asks for, in its words. A careful record of the terms as read, not legal advice. The cite-only entries agree with integration/scripts/cite-only.mjs (a test checks it both ways); stage S2a moves the tests onto this file and adds a source per column and row.

sources.changes: Every row, 3400 BC to AD 2024, in 17 files by years (a row spanning two files is in both), converted to TopoJSON quantised to 1/100,000 of each file’s extent (points that then coincide are merged; no simplification), with a row id added (omni/scripts/build-borders.mjs).
